name: NJM8801
tagline: New JRC's "mass-production MUSES": MUSES know-how on a volume process, ranked between NJM4580 and MUSES8820.

lineage.note: Applies MUSES sound-quality techniques to a mass-production process. Exact release date unknown; earliest datasheet Ver.2014-11-10.
New JRC and Ricoh Electronic Devices merged on 1 Jan 2022. Still listed on Nisshinbo product pages.

part_numbers.note: Series name, listed on the current Nisshinbo product page.
SOP8, JEDEC 150 mil; -TE2 (also -TE1) tape and reel. DigiKey: Active, not stocked.
Small SSOP8 with copper frame; in Ver. 2014-11-10. Lifecycle not found.

key_specs.condition: per package or per channel unconfirmed

reputation.summary: Niche, Japan-centric part. New JRC markets it as MUSES know-how on a mass-production process; Japanese sellers call it "MUSESの量産型" (mass-production MUSES). A Zigsow review titled "NJM4580以上MUSES8820未満" finds it close to the MUSES8820 but slightly less clear. Covered by stereo.jp. No Western bench measurements exist.
typical_uses: Preamps, reference amps, active filters, line amps (vendor list)
Pioneer OEM audio; sold as service replacement part
Hobby upgrade over NJM4580 via SOP8-to-DIP8 adapter
caveats: Sound claims rest on one Japanese user review plus vendor marketing.
Surface-mount only (SOP8, SSOP8). Socket rolling needs an adapter, which can affect stability.
Stability and output-drive limits not checked against the datasheet.

counterfeit_notes: No counterfeit reports found, though none were specifically sought. A low-volume, SMD-only Japan-market part, so fakes seem unlikely. Buy from DigiKey, Mouser or established Japanese retailers such as Kyohritsu eleshop.

open_questions: Does the Nisshinbo-labelled 2022 copy carry a new Ver. date or spec changes?
Were there editions before Ver. 2012-02-17, and did EMP8 become SOP8 by renaming only?
Is the 6 mA supply current per package or per channel? Also needed: noise frequency, current noise, output current.
Is NJM8801VA3 still in production? Not seen in the visible part of NRND notice MNG-2025-0081.
How is NJM8801 related to NJM8901?
